The outer wall is open, and the whole lane is giving crime scene energy, no cap
Two kids are still missing, nobody has slept, and the vibe is not a vibe at all
It rained on and off all day, the sky was giving tears for the whole town
Sen has gone to sit with her sister, and honestly that's the most real thing anyone has done all week
Everything smells like wet ash, the whole town is in its burnt toast era
Somebody bit clean through a lip, the adrenaline was not playing
A kid drew the men from memory, and the sketches are lowkey terrifyingly accurate
It was loud, then it was quiet, and the quiet is the worst part, no cap
Four doors need new frames, so the crew is cooked on hours for the next week
The mending starts with ~ and the vibes get worse from there
Two men worked on ~ until it was too dark to see, a whole grind arc
Nobody looked at ~ until the middle of the morning, the avoidance is unreal
The children have been kept away from ~, and the parents are not playing about it
What was done to ~ took time and both hands, respect to the crew
Somebody already started on ~ without being asked, real ones showed up
There is an argument going on about who pays for ~, and it is getting loud, very mid
Nothing can be carried in or out until somebody sees to ~, so the whole lane is stuck
In the doorway they left ~ and just went on, the audacity
Nobody has claimed ~ and it has been sitting there for two days, the lost and found is giving tragic
Everyone swears they were asleep and about half of them were, very sus
A girl of about seven bit one of them on the hand, and honestly that's the bravest thing anyone has done all week
Marks left on the door are meant to be read, and the message is loud and clear
The quiet afterwards went on for most of an hour, the longest awkward silence in town history
Two doors along, people are packing up what they have left, and the move-out energy is real
The story going around already has forty men in it, the rumor mill is unwell
A man called Hest went out to look and has not come back, and the whole town is holding its breath
On the table by the door there is ~, and nobody has touched it since it was carried in, the vibe is frozen
Two people who were nowhere near the door that night have quit the things they appointed themselves to, and a third is expected to follow, the self-appointed committee got canceled
There is talk of going out after them, and the talk has names in it now, and the older ones have started sitting in on it, the group chat is spiraling
The blame has settled, without anybody deciding it, on the one who sleeps nearest the door, and he has stopped coming out at meals, a whole unfair vibe nobody asked for

Counting what is gone was started twice and abandoned twice, once because the woman doing it was called away and once because the man who took over could not read her marks, and it is being started again this evening, the inventory is giving chaos
The men who came up from the far end an hour too late have spent all day explaining where they were, and the excuse gets shorter every time, and nobody has asked since noon, the L is loud
It happened in broad daylight, and somehow nobody saw it coming, the whole day was cooked
Nothing about the way they came in was quiet or quick, the entrance was not subtle at all
They stood out in the open long enough to be counted, zero stealth and zero plan B
Nobody here knew their faces, which made it worse, no cap
They spoke to nobody and took only what two men could carry, a very precise crew
None of the old people can put a name to the marks on the door, and the vibe check is failing
They went through the place without once raising their voices, which is being talked about more than the damage, the silence has the whole town shook
The blood has been washed twice and it is still not coming out, the stain is so real
Two of the dead were laid out in the same room as the living, and the whole house is quiet, this is heavy and real
Somebody named {subject} out loud, and the room went cold, lowkey terrifying
The talk is all of {subject}, every corner of town is in the rumor mill
A name has been scratched into the door frame, and the name is {subject}, the message is loud
The children have learned to spell {subject} this week, and they say it like a curse word
Nobody here ever traded with {subject}, and after this nobody ever will, that's the whole vibe
Somebody in the back room keeps saying {subject} over and over, a loop nobody can stop
The old quarrel with {subject} got a great deal worse last night, the beef is officially serious
Two of the wounded said {subject} before they went quiet, and a third said a word nobody here knows, and it has been written down as best anyone could manage, so the record is locked in
Whoever came in knew exactly where to find the {res}, the whole raid was on a schedule
Everything else got stepped over on the way to the {res}, pure tunnel vision, very sus
The floor where the {res} used to sit has been swept and swept again, by a man who was told to stop an hour ago, the cleaning arc is unhinged
Somebody stood in front of {res_stores} with both arms out, got shoved to the floor for it, and has been retelling it since morning with the arms still out, the main character moment was tragic

The number going around out loud this evening is {amt_res}, but the two who did the counting wrote down a different number, and the argument about it is happening in the back room, the math is not mathing
Whoever pointed them at the {res} lives here, eats here, and was standing in the lane this morning with everybody else, the vibe is so betrayed
A boy chalked {amt_res} on the wall by the door because he heard it said, and two people rubbed it out, and it went back up both times in a bigger hand, the kid is not having it
Two names are chalked up and nobody is erasing them, the list is lowkey heavy
Half the animals came home on their own, and the town is still out looking for the rest, the hope arc is real
The dogs turned up ~ under the wall at first light, the pack energy was unreal
Halfway up the lane somebody picked up ~, and nobody wanted to be the one to say it out loud, the vibes are heavy
The dogs went off an hour before anyone got up, and the whole lane was awake and shook
A woman down the lane counted them going past and got to nine, and that number is lowkey terrifying
Grey dog is gone and the children have been told, and the whole lane is taking it hard
The baker went at them with a shovel and got hurt for it, respect to the bravest bread-maker alive
A boy who was in the loft the whole time has described the men twice, and both descriptions are of the same man, the witness is so consistent
Somebody has been going door to door with a stick of chalk writing down what each place has lost, and has been let in everywhere, the community organizing is giving
Every roof on the water side wants work before the cold comes, and the roofer is one of the two who have not been found, the group chat is begging for him
The washing was out on the line when it started and is still out on the line, and the woman it belongs to has not been back in the house, the laundry is a whole sad arc
An old man came down to the water at first light with a bucket, filled it, looked at the far bank for a while, and carried it back up, pure quiet strength
Two of ours went down in the lane and one of theirs went down with them, ours have been carried in, washed and laid out, and the third is still lying where he fell, nobody here is calling this a win

Word had gone round by midmorning that they came through the water side, and by evening that they came down the lane, and by now that somebody here walked out and showed them the way in, the rumor mill has zero chill

A woman has been at the door since first light asking whether anybody saw her son go past, and she has asked everybody on the row, and two of them have started avoiding the lane so as not to be asked again, the avoidance is so real
They made no attempt to come in unseen and walked out the same way, and one of them stopped in the lane to drink, so brazen and so weird

A man at the end of the lane did nothing the whole time except stand and watch the rest work, and four separate people have described him, and the four descriptions agree, the bystander is in the chat
The lane is still blocked, and the whole street is on pause
Three graves, and one is small, the quiet is so heavy
The children were kept in the back room all morning while the lane was cleared, and they were let out at noon and went straight to the wall to look, the curiosity is unstoppable

There is a version going round in which the whole thing lasted an hour and there were thirty of them, and a shorter version told by the two who were actually out in the lane, and the long one is winning, the group chat has no chill
A boy refuses to let go of ~ he found in the mud, the stubborn energy is unmatched
They left one of their own face down in the mud, and nobody here can make sense of that, it is so unsettling
Nine barrows of rubble so far, and the count keeps going up, the cleanup arc has no end
The digging is being done by whoever can still hold a spade, the whole town is doing its part
A woman has been sitting with a body since dawn, and nobody has the heart to ask her to stop, the grief is so real
The council sat before it was light and by midday had agreed to meet again, the meeting energy is unmatched
Lamps were lit all night and are lit now, and nobody has said out loud that they will be lit tomorrow as well, the vibe is 24/7 vigil
The well was cleaned out and the water is being carried up from further along, which will go on until somebody can say the well is fit to drink from, the hydration situation is cooked
Wounded people were brought in and the doors were barred behind them, the whole house is on lockdown mode
Third night with the lamps lit, the candles are doing the most
Whoever let them in knew which way the bar lifted, and that is the most sus detail anyone has said all week
Word got to the next place along the water before first light, the warning chain is so efficient
Blood in the wash water, and the laundry day is cooked
It smells of burning down by the water and will for days, that smell is not going anywhere, bestie
Somebody cut a shape into the wall down by the water, a mark that means something to the people who live there, and nobody here knows what it says yet
Whoever they were, they walked a long way to get here, which is commitment, and that's the lowkey scariest part
The woman who washes the dead has kept back ~ and given it to the boy who sweeps her step, the quiet kindness is the whole vibe
There was no moon at all, which they clearly planned around, because the two nights before were bright enough to read by, the villain planning was immaculate

The man keeping watch tonight kept watch last night and the night before too, and everyone who passes the ladder has told him to go lie down, and he is still up on the wall, the stubborn guard arc is real
Bread got left outside, a whole carb tragedy
Standing still, the man on the wall saw them and stayed where he was, pure main character composure
The back door was open from the inside, which is so sus, somebody in there had a plan
Two houses on the corner were missed entirely, lowkey the luckiest corner in town
The wall goes up again in the morning, higher this time, and the man who said it was high enough two years ago has been reminded of that by everybody carrying stone, the L is his now
Everything that could be moved indoors was moved before the light came up, and most of it has been carried back out since because the houses are full, the storage arc is chaos
The wind was up all evening and covered most of the noise, so the first anybody knew was a door going in, a sneaky weather situation
Littlest kid was under the floor the whole time and did not make a sound, and has been carried about by three different people today, and has been asleep for most of it, the GOAT of hide and seek

The rebuilding was started before the ash had gone cold, by two men who had been up all night and were not asked to, and there is now a good deal of new timber in the wrong place, the enthusiasm is giving chaos
A line of spilled {res} runs down the back stairs and along the passage, and it will be there a while yet, the mess is not going anywhere

Two of them walked out of the low door carrying {res_haul} between them at no particular speed, and one looked back at the house before he went, and four people saw that and none of them describe him the same way, the witness testimony is a mess
Nobody had thought to move the {res} indoors, and the two people who told everyone to move it have not said so again, which everybody has noticed, the passive aggressive energy is loud
The people who were loudest about the wall being high enough have gone indoors, and the people who were quiet about it are being kind, mostly, the main character drama is over
Damage report is still loading, and the progress bar is lowkey lying
They took the backups first, which means they knew where the backups were, the planning is so sus
Four sections are sealed and the people inside have been told help is coming, which is true in the sense that it is scheduled, the ETA is giving fiction
Every screen in the sector went dark at the same moment and came back a minute later showing the correct time, the glitch was so polite
The casualty list is being updated live, and the updates are giving horror movie
Emergency lighting is on in the residential levels and will stay on, and the children have already stopped asking when the proper lights are coming back, they adapted faster than the adults
Survivors are asked to report to the nearest intact terminal, which is giving very nerdy hero call
The insurers have described the attack as an act of war, which the people who were in it could have told them for free
Working out what was taken will take longer than the raid did, and the people doing it need more people, the audit arc is brutal
The security doors opened for them, and the doors were lowkey traitors
Sirens ran all night, and nobody could sleep through that, the vibe was all siren
Triage took until morning, and it was a very long shift, no cap
Every camera recorded the wrong corridor, and the footage is giving nothing
The evacuation drill worked, so all the practice runs finally paid off, big W
Level four has no power, and the lights are giving off-grid survival mode
All access codes have been changed, and the security team is in full lockdown mode
They used a maintenance code that was supposed to have been retired years ago, and the retirement paperwork is looking very sus
The medics set up in the lobby, and it has not been a lobby since, the vibe changed completely
Shutters came down on the wrong side of half the residents, the shutter drama is unreal
The security review has found that every procedure was followed and that the procedures were the problem, the process is so cooked
Backup generators came on and ran the lights and nothing else, a very limited power-up energy
The injured were sorted with color-coded tags until the tags ran out, and nobody could keep up
Insurers want a list of what was taken, itemized, with receipts, and the receipts are the real drama
A security guard held one door for twenty minutes and has asked not to be thanked in public, the quiet W of the night
The alarm system logged every breach and sent the alerts to an address that closed last year, the tech stack is so cooked
Official count is lower than the count going round the residential levels, and the gap is giving serious rumor energy
Whatever they came for was on the lower levels, and they knew which lift to take, the planning was immaculate
Families from the damaged section are sleeping in the sports hall, and the gym is doing its best
The facial recognition system identified every one of them as a member of staff, the system is so unhinged
List of the missing is updated every hour on a screen in the main hall, and the crowd in front of it gets smaller each time a name comes off, the hope is draining in real time
A minister arrived by evening, was shown the damage, said lessons would be learned, and was driven back out through the breach the raiders used, the photo op was so cringe
The door logs show them entering at one end of the complex and leaving at the other in under twenty minutes, stopping only where the stores were, speedrun energy
Every resident has been sent a form for reporting losses, and the form was written for a burglary, and it has a box for the make of the bicycle, the bureaucracy is delulu

A teenager who hid in a ventilation duct the whole time has been interviewed four times and gets the same details right every time, which makes him the most useful witness they have, the GOAT of hiding
The breach in the outer wall is being covered with temporary panels, and children have already started drawing on them, the art is the only good part

Automated defenses spent the raid guarding the parts of the complex that were not being attacked, as they had been programmed to, and the engineer who wrote that code has been at a terminal ever since going through it line by line, the code is so sus

The canteen stayed open all night because the woman who runs it would not close it, and by morning she had fed the medics, the guards and the families from the damaged section, and she has gone home now and is not to be called, legend
Lifts are locked down, so the stairs are giving cardio arc
Two guards are unaccounted for, and nobody is joking about that
Emergency powers were declared and then read, and the paperwork is giving a whole reading list
The atrium glass is gone, and the lobby is now an open-air situation
Power came back in the wrong order and the doors on the east side stayed sealed until noon, the system is cooked
The residents' forum has already named the person who let them in, and has named four different people, the group chat has zero facts
Field hospital in the car park has run out of beds and started using the reclining chairs from the staff lounge, very lowkey comfy
Repairs have been estimated, and the estimate has been sent back with a request for a smaller one, the budget is in its unhinged era
A child was found asleep under a desk in the admin block the next morning, having slept through the whole of it, the most unbothered sleeper ever
The night staff want to know why the raid alert reached the day staff first, and the chain of command is giving drama
Sprinklers put out the fire in the stores and flooded the level below, where the spare equipment was kept, a whole plot twist of the water
Names of the dead were read out over the public address system at noon, and every corridor in the complex stopped to listen, the quiet was so heavy
Shutters are still down, and that is not giving open for business
Every door log has a gap in it, and the gaps are sus
Two stairwells are sealed with tape, and the vibe is caution tape only
The lost property office has been turned over to the belongings of the missing, and that is not the vibe at all
Everyone was handed a foil blanket and most of them are still wearing one, the whole complex is cosplaying a baked potato
The blood bank ran low by midnight and a queue formed in the corridor to give more, the community showed up hard
Insurance assessors arrived before the fire crews had finished, and the speed is unhinged
The one lift that still works has a queue and a guard, and the VIP experience is gone

Names of the missing went up on the whiteboard in the canteen, and they have been rubbed out one at a time through the day as people turned up, and the last three have been circled, the board is a whole emotional rollercoaster
Word on the residential levels is that they had a floor plan, and the rumor is lowkey accurate
Residents are asked not to post photographs of the breach, and the group chat is being told to log off
Four doors breached, two stores emptied, one guard still in surgery, and the stats are not it
The maintenance crew are on their thirtieth hour and have started writing the time on every work order they sign, the grind is real and tragic
They set off every alarm on purpose on the way out, and the exit was chaotic and intentional
Nobody got a word from them, and their suits carried no markings, the silent treatment was the whole plan
The morgue ran out of drawers and borrowed a cold store, and the storage situation is cooked

A woman from the damaged section has been going door to door on the upper levels with a photograph of her son on her phone, and every door has opened for her, and nobody behind any of them has seen him, the hope arc is heavy
Two huts are down, and the village is in its rebuild era
The store-pit was emptied by hand, and the pantry is cooked
Drums went up too late, and the alarm was a whole L
Smoke on the ridge until noon, and the sky has been in its gray era
Nobody goes past the racks, the racks are off limits, no cap
They drove off half the herd and killed what would not walk, and the herd situation is brutal
A spear was left standing in the ground by the store-pit, and everyone is clocking it
Somebody let the watch-fire go out well before midnight, and the night shift is in the group chat
An arrow came through the roof of the wrong hut, and the aim was lowkey unhinged
They crossed at the ford, which everyone had said they would not, and the call was a fail
The hides put out to dry are gone or trampled into the mud, and the leather is not coming back
Spring below the camp has blood in it and is being left alone, the water is off the menu
A boy went after them with a spear and was carried back, and the bravery is real but the outcome is not the vibe
Half the harvest was still in the ground, which saved it, and the late planting was a glow-up
The valley people watched them go past and lit nothing at all, and the silence was unbothered
A hide with a hand-mark on it was tied to the post by the path, and the calling card is loud
The elders have been sitting since before light and have sent for the old woman who remembers the last time, and she is coming up the slope now, the council is calling in the veteran
Water has been carried up from the ford all morning by whoever could be spared, and the two women doing most of it have not been relieved once, the water squad is locked in
The column that came through was longer than the camp is wide, which two people have now said out loud and nobody has argued with, and the math is brutal
An old woman stood in her doorway with a spear held wrong and they went around her, and she has been standing in the same place most of the day, the boss energy is undefeated
The tracks go up the valley and stop where the ground turns hard, and two men followed them that far and came back and have not said much since, the trail went cold
Somebody has cut marks into the post beside the store-pit, one for each of ours, and a boy has been sent to ask the elders whether that is allowed, the tally is giving grim

Three huts stand open with nothing in them, and the families are in with other families, and the old man who lived alone in the fourth has gone up to sit by the store-pit, the roommate situation is intense

They fired the drying racks on the way out and the dogs went in every direction, and half of them were back before dawn and the rest are still somewhere up on the slope, the dog search is giving chaos
The gate stood open, and the security is delulu
Supper went cold in the hall, and the vibes ghosted the table
Two carts are gone, and the wagon situation is an L
The bells rang late, and the timing was so mid
Wax still soft on the letter, so somebody is reading the mail, and the drama is fresh
Riders were through the village before the bells started, and the warning was a no-show
The storehouse doors were taken off their hinges and left in the yard, zero respect for the doors
Two pickets were found tied up and unhurt and are being asked about it, and the questions are going around
Our steward has counted what is left and started again from the top, the count is in a loop
A clerk was hurt carrying the rolls out and will keep the hand, and the rolls are safe, the clerk is a hero
Nobody called the militia until the whole of it was over, and the response time is so mid
The muster is called for dawn and nobody expects much of it, and the turnout is giving low battery
An arrow went through the shutter and stuck in the beam, and the aim is not it
Somebody has hung a torn banner over the gate arch, and the statement is loud
The undercroft was found open and most of the way empty, and the basement is a whole nothing
Column came up the road past the ford in good order, and the organization was immaculate
A herald came the next morning with something on parchment that the steward read once, folded, and put inside his coat without saying a word about it, the drama is so quiet
The village below lost most of its roofs and blames the gate for it, and two families have already carried their things up the road to relatives, the blame game is unhinged
Quartermaster will not begin counting until the yard is cleared, and the yard cannot be cleared until the carts are mended, and the carter is at the ford, the to-do list is cursed
Gate keeper is dead and his son has been all round the village asking who had the bar up last, and has been politely answered at every door, and nobody is giving the answer away
Smoke stood over the harvest fields until the rain came in the afternoon, and the men who went out to beat it down came back black to the elbow, the fields are cooked
The bells go again at first light, by order of the steward, and the boy who rings them has been given a stool and told to stay by the rope, bell duty is a whole job now
Two wagons were taken and a third went into the ditch at the bend, and it has been got out and stands in the yard with a broken axle and a great deal of opinion around it, the wagon is an icon

The horns went up in the wrong order, which had the militia running to the ford while the riders were already inside the yard, and the man who blew them has been stood down and is sitting in the hall, the horn situation is an L
Phone line got cut first, so the group chat died instantly
Two men have not come in, and the group chat is holding its breath
A bullet went through the depot clock at twenty past four, the timing was so cursed
Smoke over the yard till dawn, the air is giving apocalypse
Freight left lying in the mud, the cargo is cooked
The way in was along the rail siding, on foot, zero vehicles, pure stealth mode
Warehouse doors got cut and the lock left hanging on the chain, the security is so cooked
A night watchman is in hospital, the real MVP who kept his eye on the gate
The foreman was on the platform for all of it, and the boss energy was not helping
Two lorries went out after them and came back with nothing, the chase arc was an L
The payroll safe was opened with something heavy and unhurried, the safe got served
Wire to the next station was down the whole night, the comms are cooked
It will be written up in triplicate and read by nobody, bureaucracy at its most mid
Somebody telegraphed the wrong office and lost forty minutes doing it, a whole comms fail
Nobody has seen the depot cat since Tuesday night, and the group chat is spiraling about the cat
They knew which shed held the good stock and walked past two others, the research was immaculate
The office clock stopped at the minute the wall took the blow, and three men have written that time down separately and two of the three agree, the timeline is locked in
Men are sleeping in the warehouse tonight with the lamps left burning, and the foreman has said nothing about the cost of the oil, the vibe is cozy and tense
The valley road was blocked behind them with a felled tree, and the two men sent to clear it took until noon and came back saying the cuts were fresh, the plan was so sus
Shareholders will be told about the fence and the lock, and the meeting has been moved back a week, the stakeholder drama is loud
A column of them walked out along the rail line in the dark, and nobody thought to stop the goods train, which went through at half past four and saw nothing, the timing was so clean
The annexe roof is holed in two places and the paper under it is ruined, and the two women who keep the files have been drying sheets on the office stove, the paperwork is in its drying era
Telegram went out an hour after they had gone, and the reply came back in the morning telling the yard to secure the fence, which is where the fence used to be, the response is so behind

The foreman's account and the watchman's account differ on the number of them and on the hour, and both men have been asked to write it out again, and both have written out the same thing again, the testimony is giving deja vu
Feed went dark early, so the stream never got its ending
Power first, then the doors, the security stack is so cooked
Two guards are in hospital, and we are sending them every good vibe
The night analyst is still up, the grind is unreal
Nobody wants tomorrow's after-action, the report is giving dread
Two drones went up late and found dust and a cold engine, the search was an L
The uplink was cut at the pole outside the fence, and the cut was so intentional
An analyst watched the whole of it and could do nothing, the helplessness is real
The network is back and half the cameras are still down, the comeback is incomplete
Somebody put the footage out before the shift had ended, and the leak was immediate
The channel filled up with people who were nowhere near it, the crowd showed up for nothing
Service road was used both ways, with every light off, the stealth was real
The last clean image is a shoulder and half a face, zero detail, maximum sus
Badge reader logged forty entries inside one minute, the speed is unhinged
They knew the camera angles better than the guards did, the homework was done
Three doors opened on credentials that expired last year, the IT department is cooked
The drones are grounded until somebody accounts for the eleven minutes, and the person who has to account for them went home at four and has not been reached, the eleven minutes are a whole mystery

A junior analyst called it in four minutes before it started and was told to hold, and has since had to say exactly what she saw to everybody above her, the warning was ignored and it is not her fault
Half the floor has watched the same nine seconds of footage since morning, and the room has agreed on the number of them and on nothing else, the group chat is in shambles
Somebody's phone is still transmitting from inside a bag somewhere on the far side of the fence, and it has been listened to for six hours and has given up two coughs, the bag is the only witness
The network logged the whole thing as a maintenance window, which is what it was told to log, and the person who scheduled the window is on leave until Thursday, the scheduling is so cursed
A drone found the vehicles four hours later on a track behind the reservoir, all three of them burnt out and parked neatly, one behind the other, the parking is giving precision

The channel logs stop for nine minutes and start again clean, and the two people who could say why are the two people who were on the desk, and both of them have been sent home to sleep, the timeline is so sus

Uplink came back on its own at ten to six, and the first thing through it was a maintenance ticket filed the evening before about a door sensor on the east side, which has now been read by about forty people, the ticket is going viral
The drones were hacked first, and the hack was so clean
Raid trended before it ended, the timeline was not ready
Every feed cut at once, a perfect blackout
The accounts were drained in seconds and the bank is investigating, the seconds were brutal
Their malware is still somewhere on the network and the analysts are hunting it floor by floor, the bug hunt is intense
An analyst watched the whole thing on a feed from home and called it in before the building's own systems noticed, the main character analyst of the night
The drones that were supposed to defend the compound were turned around and used against it, the betrayal arc is unreal
Raiders left a message on every screen in the building, and it has a spelling mistake in it, and the analysts are treating the spelling mistake as a clue, the typo is the plot
The fusion plant tripped to safe mode when the grid dropped, and the city went dark for an hour, the safety switch did its job
After-action review has been asked to explain how an attack this large came through a network this closely watched, and would like more time, the review is buffering
People filmed it on their phones from the flats across the street, and the footage is better than anything the security system kept, the civilians are the real security
Their implants made them invisible to our cameras and easy to see for a cleaner with a mop, who passed them in the service corridor and took them for contractors, the cleaner noticed everything
Jamming came from their drones, and it was lowkey genius
The fusion plant was never touched, which is the one W in the whole report
Lobby feed shows them holding the door for each other, the manners are so cursed
The police arrived in time to photograph the tire marks, the investigation is giving CSI
An analyst traced their vehicles to a rented garage across the city and found it swept clean, the cover-up is immaculate
